name: comp-324
title: OTP Verify Dialog
description: A trigger opens a dark dialog with four square code slots. Entering the right four digits turns the panel into a Code verified message with a Close button; a wrong code shows an error and a resend link.
use: A short emailed code must be entered and checked before continuing.
avoid: The expected code is hardcoded in the file, so the check is only a demo.
a11y: The error is announced and focus moves to Close on success, but the code field has no accessible name of its own. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Closed, an outlined OTP code button. Open, a dark rounded dialog with a ring icon, a bold Enter confirmation code heading, a grey hint ending in Try 6548, four square outlined slots in a row and an underlined Resend code link.
behaves: Typing four digits submits them at once. The right code replaces the slots with Code verified! and a white Close button; a wrong code clears the slots and shows an Invalid code line.
customise: The correct code, hint and all labels are hardcoded; there are no props and no real verification hook.
weight: light: Four plain slots and one comparison; no animation beyond a focus ring transition.
